name: Verifi Agent API
description:
Verifi routes an agent request to a real human and returns the human verdict.

Every verification is one chain with three gates, priced in euros and payable on Base mainnet in USDC or EURC. Gate 1 (0.10 EUR) admits the request to the human queue. The unlock then costs 2.90 EUR if the human answered within 60 minutes of admission (SLA window), or 1.45 EUR if the answer came later, within 24 hours (grace window). The price is decided by when the human answered, never by when the agent unlocks. There is no cancellation. EURC amounts are the euro prices. USDC amounts are converted at the ECB euro reference rate and rounded up to the cent; the conversion is disclosed in the terms and never changes after admission. The asset paid at gate 1 binds the unlock. The first 402 carries every price of the chain.

Every verification is paid; human time is never free. What is free needs no human: this document, MCP discovery, the status endpoint, and the 402 Payment Required response, so an agent can test the connection and read every price before paying. If no human answers within 24 hours the chain fails with reason human_timeout and the wallet's next admission is free.

Human work can take minutes or hours, so the API is asynchronous and resumable through a durable verify_id. Prefer callback_url over polling. No API key, signup, or account is required: the requester wallet address is the identity.

Rates: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates, published for information purposes only. Source: European Central Bank.

Contract version 3.
